item.title: TTT 3: Heart Attacks Ain't Nothing But Trouble
item.description:
In this back to regular length episode, Eric & Rachelle discuss David Lee Roth, heart attacks, why 600 Starbucks stores closing isn’t big of a deal, and why first world countries are first world countries.
